cohort: The study included infants between 1 and 4 months of age, divided into a case group with constipation issues and a control group without, along with their mothers.
finding: Functional constipation in infants aged 1-4 months was significantly associated with cesarean section, formula feeding, maternal low-fiber diet, and a familial history of altered defecation patterns or constipation.
mod_finding: The incidence of functional constipation was notably elevated in infants born via cesarean section.
cross-section timing: Infants between 1 and 4 months of age
